FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_CalculateOutput
VAR_INPUT
    i: INT; // Input integer
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    o: INT; // Output integer
END_VAR
VAR
    tempOutput: INT; // Temporary variable for output calculation
END_VAR

// Main logic
IF i = 0 THEN
    tempOutput := 0; // Case 1: i = 0, output is 0
ELSIF (i >= 1) AND (i <= 5) THEN
    tempOutput := i * i; // Case 2: i between 1 and 5, output is square of i
ELSIF (i >= 6) AND (i <= 10) THEN
    tempOutput := i + (2 * i); // Case 3: i between 6 and 10, output is i + 2*i
ELSE
    tempOutput := -1; // Case 4: i outside defined ranges, output is -1
END_IF;

// Assign the calculated value to the output
o := tempOutput;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
